title: Dolores and the Cave
author: Magda Knight
description:
COME INTO THE CAVE, DOLORES. NOTHING BAD EVER HAPPENED IN A CAVE.

Welcome. You have your team, your caving gear, your equipment. You're all set to descend into a previously unexplored cave - the find of a lifetime. But as you abseil down you hear the rumble of a cave-in, and that's the last thing you remember.

Then a voice starts talking to you in the dark...

***

Dolores and the Cave is a ten-minute horror game with nine different endings to explore.

Don't worry, Dolores.

Nothing bad ever happened in a cave.
